description: This file implements POSIX timer functionalities for Zephyr OS, including timer creation, deletion, and management with support for signal notifications and threading.

methods.name: zephyr_timer_wrapper
methods.description: Callback invoked when the timer expires, calls the notify function if set.

methods.name: zephyr_thread_wrapper
methods.description: Thread function that waits on semaphore and calls notify function.

methods.name: zephyr_timer_interrupt
methods.description: Interrupt handler that signals the semaphore.

methods.name: timer_create
methods.description: Creates a POSIX timer with specified notification method.

methods.name: timer_gettime
methods.description: Retrieves remaining time and interval for a timer.

methods.name: timer_settime
methods.description: Sets expiration and interval for a timer.

methods.name: timer_getoverrun
methods.description: Returns overrun count for a timer.

methods.name: timer_delete
methods.description: Deletes a timer and cleans up resources.
